result.title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sotamak1r.github.io/SF2-web/
result.summary: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出少步视频扩散蒸馏中 DMD 仅有输出空间目标，步数极少时空间细节与时间一致性退化，提出 Self Flow Forcing：在保留 DMD 输出目标的同时，通过给学生与 EMA 教师不同噪声水平制造信息不对称，让学生从更受损输入预测教师内部表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 「从更受损输入预测教师内部表示」的非对称表示监督，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的对齐与轨迹训练提供可核查线索，但其为视频生成蒸馏方法，能否迁移到推理状态尚待判断。
